role_definitions.Pi: original experimentally distinguished individual/model state and context boundary
role_definitions.X: configuration carriers: rate activations, current network state and separately initialized connection weights
role_definitions.Q: criterion-conditioned learning accuracy/interference and recall metric filters, not an invented learner coordinator
role_definitions.P: P_in imposed item, context, AB/AC training and RP/RS interventions; P_out recall, time, RSA and cycle probes
role_definitions.K: original typed Leabra conductance activation and source implemented error-plus-BCM XCAL weight transformations
role_definitions.T: actual computational phase quarters, trial succession and weight updates
role_definitions.O: boundary-relative source reported synthetic performance and separate externally cited empirical data

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: ECin pools encode item and list-context input; externally constructed test patterns use two item and four context pools
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Experimenter-given stimuli/protocol must not be represented as learned internal world generation

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: ECin projects broadly via perforant path to DG/CA3 with source-stated random 25% connectivity
Leabra FFFB competition and strong DG/CA3 inhibition induce sparse activity; source setting DG 3.8 and CA3 2.8 vs default 1.8
Original model uses ECin, DG, CA3, CA1, ECout interacting bidirectionally with different theta-quarter route dominance
Direct ECin→CA3 pre-DG response and later DG-driven CA3 response define distinct short-latency learning states
CA3 error-driven synaptic contrast is ECin sender activity multiplied by DG-late CA3 activity minus direct ECin-earlier CA3 activity; affects ECin→CA3 and recurrent CA3↔CA3
Actual software Leabra XCAL learning combines short/medium contrast-dependent error term and nonzero long-average BCM Hebbian term, not a universal pure delta rule
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Appendix qualifies nonzero Hebbian component; source title alone not mathematical definition

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: An ECin→DG projection retains Hebbian learning without an equivalent available error contrast; weight-decrease versus increase balance was tuned
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Appendix qualifies nonzero Hebbian component; source title alone not mathematical definition

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: Original model has source-differentiated solid mixed error/Hebbian, dashed Hebbian-only, dotted no-learning projections
Network activations use integrated excitatory conductance and feedforward/feedback inhibition, not abstract stateless lookup
Learning uses AvgSS/AvgS/AvgM/AvgL, AvgSLrn and XCAL with conditional thresholding and bounded sigmoidal contrast weights
The modeled theta-like trial is computationally represented as four quarters over ~100ms alpha cycle, whereas biological theta ~200ms; timing equivalence is an author-tested modeling assumption
Model sizes are small/medium/large: DG 44x44, 67x67, 89x89; CA3 20x20, 30x30, 40x40; others specified in original S1 Table
AB list trained before AC reassignments with contextual pools, each to 100% recall or at most 15 epochs, and AB/AC tested as appropriate
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Experimenter-given stimuli/protocol must not be represented as learned internal world generation

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: AB–AC item pairs were varied from 20 to 100 and network sizes varied; training time N and AB residual retention M were source performance metrics
Optional five-epoch monosynaptic EC↔CA1 pretraining with DG and CA3 inactive supplied prior semantic-learning approximation; its ablation is explicit

Author tested NoEDL matched CA3 new error algorithm, NoDynMF recall mossy fiber strength, NoDGLearn and NoPretrain interventions plus older ThetaPhase comparison; interventions are not all fully matched pairwise factorial trials
Reducing rather than abolishing DG mossy-fiber input during recall was useful; original test effect depends on list size and settings
Compared with earlier ThetaPhase, authors report Theremin greater AB interference resistance and learning speed within their specified list sizes/network sizes
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Author-reported modeled performance observation, not exact W3 numerical replication

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: Author original Fig4 controlled variant results support contributions from CA3 EDL, dynamic mossy fiber strength, DG learning and pretraining under their specific tests
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Author-reported modeled performance observation, not exact W3 numerical replication

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: Authors report DG learning-rate/interference and speed tradeoff; no universal single best rate for both speed and residual memory
Author original representational similarity within/between AB and AC shows CA3 differentiation in Theremin versus greater overlap in NoEDL, limited to modeled 100-item medium network analysis
Cycle-resolved patterns show late DG-driven CA3 state after first quarter and increasing first-quarter resemblance over epochs; original Fig6 also shows potential big-loop deviations
Testing-effect model specifically uses small 100-pair AB-only design, 30 synthetic runs per condition, 10% context drift, source-specified clamping and disabled learning route modifications
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Experimenter-given stimuli/protocol must not be represented as learned internal world generation

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: Authors report simulated Theremin retrieval-practice > restudy but NoEDL reverses under their conditions; human experimental comparison is inherited from separate published study not collected by model paper
complete_original_A_roles.comment: Author-reported modeled performance observation, not exact W3 numerical replication

complete_original_A_roles.source_native_kind: Original architecture inherits Ketz/Morkonda/O'Reilly 2013 theta-phase hippocampus and CLS/Leabra mechanism; no independent historical exact code/version replay was performed by W3
